title: Making Friends
summary: 国际社交、兴趣交流、现在完成时入门。
objectives: Start conversations and ask follow-up questions
Discuss experiences and specific past events

lessons.title: Start a Conversation
lessons.subtitle: 用共同场景开启对话
grammar: Is this your first time ...?；开放式问句

vocabulary.example: I’m here for the language exchange.

listening.title: Start a Conversation
listening.transcript: Is this your first time at the exchange? Mine too. I’m here to practise Spanish. How did you hear about the group?

questions.q: What language does the speaker want to practise?

passages.title: A phone reminder
passages.transcript: Hi, I’m calling from the language café to confirm your booking. We’re holding the language exchange on Monday. It starts at 9 fifteen. You can call back if you’d like to change your booking.

questions.q: On which day does the event take place?
What time does the event begin?

passages.title: At the front desk
passages.transcript: Welcome to the language café! Are you here for the language exchange? Please meet us in the Maple Room. The session lasts 25 minutes. It begins at 9 fifteen. I can show you where to go.

passages.title: A ticket enquiry
passages.transcript: Thanks for asking about the language exchange. It lasts 25 minutes. A ticket costs 11 pounds. We have space for 10 people. We’ll give you a map when you arrive.

passages.title: A message from the organiser
passages.transcript: A quick note for everyone joining the language exchange at the language café. There are 10 places. Use the north entrance. Please bring a pencil. If you need help, ask for Leo. See you there!

questions.q: What are visitors asked to bring?

passages.title: Online booking page
passages.text: Language exchange bookings close at 12:00. Reserve your place online before that time. Look for a confirmation in your email inbox.

questions.q: When is the online booking deadline?

passages.title: Ticket collection sign
passages.text: Ticket collection: show your confirmation at the language café information desk. If you arrive late, wait by the entrance until a member of staff comes to meet you.

grammar: 综合一般过去时、现在完成时和礼貌追问

vocabulary.example: Would you like to join us?

listening.title: Weekly Challenge: Make a New Friend
listening.transcript: I’m new to the city and I like photography. I’ve never been to the riverside market. Some friends are going there on Sunday, and you’re welcome to come.

questions.q: Where are the friends going on Sunday?

passages.title: A phone reminder
passages.transcript: Hi, I’m calling from the language café to confirm your booking. We’re holding the language exchange on Sunday. It starts at 15 fifteen. You can call back if you’d like to change your booking.

questions.q: On which day does the event take place?
What time does the event begin?

passages.title: At the front desk
passages.transcript: Welcome to the language café! Are you here for the language exchange? Please meet us in the Oak Room. The session lasts 45 minutes. It begins at 15 fifteen. I can show you where to go.

passages.title: A ticket enquiry
passages.transcript: Thanks for asking about the language exchange. It lasts 45 minutes. A ticket costs 12 pounds. We have space for 22 people. We’ll give you a map when you arrive.

passages.title: A message from the organiser
passages.transcript: A quick note for everyone joining the language exchange at the language café. There are 22 places. Use the south entrance. Please bring a pencil. If you need help, ask for Maya. See you there!

questions.q: What are visitors asked to bring?

speaking.prompt: 模拟两分钟聊天，先聊摄影，再问一次经历并确认集合时间。
speaking.sample: I enjoy taking photos too. Have you ever joined a photo walk? Do you mean eleven outside the market?

practice.prompt: 用两句英语回答「Weekly Challenge: Make a New Friend」的场景。用到 keep in touch，并给一个具体细节。
checklist: 与 Weekly Challenge: Make a New Friend 场景有关

practice.prompt: 你想参加 language café 的 language exchange。向工作人员询问地点和开始时间。
你的同伴没听清刚才的活动通知。用自己的话复述日期、房间和费用。
同伴无法按时到达 language exchange。告诉对方你会怎么办，并询问对方是否同意。
checklist: 用问句确认对方是否同意

reading.title: 完成开场、追问、邀约与确认
reading.text: Photo walk: meet outside the market at eleven. Bring a camera or phone. The walk is free, but space is limited to twelve people. Send Jo a message to join.

passages.title: Online booking page
passages.text: Language exchange bookings close at 12:00. Reserve your place online before that time. Look for a confirmation in your email inbox.

questions.q: When is the online booking deadline?

passages.title: Ticket collection sign
passages.text: Ticket collection: show your confirmation at the language café information desk. If you arrive late, wait by the entrance until a member of staff comes to meet you.

questions.q: Where do you collect your ticket?

passages.title: Payment instructions
passages.text: Pay by card when you book the language exchange. Keep the confirmation email until the event is over.

passages.title: Message for participants
passages.text: Plans changed? You can move your booking free of charge until Sunday. If you arrive late, please wait at the entrance until a member of staff comes to meet you.

writing.prompt: 写 85–105 词跟进这次见面，提到共同兴趣、问一个问题并确认活动。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（综合一般过去时、现在完成时和礼貌追问）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

practice.prompt: 给朋友写 2–3 句关于「Weekly Challenge: Make a New Friend」的英语消息，使用 keep in touch 并补充一个具体细节。
写 25–40 词邀请朋友参加 language exchange，写明时间、房间和要带的物品。
写 25–40 词给将要迟到的朋友，根据阅读通知告诉对方到哪里等、向谁求助。
写 35–50 词说明你在「Weekly Challenge: Make a New Friend」场景中的选择与理由，尽量运用本课语法（综合一般过去时、现在完成时和礼貌追问）。

quiz.explanation: Have you ever 提问不限某个具体的过去时刻。
options: Have you ever joined a photo walk?
Did you join one last Sunday?
quiz.answer: Have you ever joined a photo walk?
quiz.prompt: Which question asks about experience without naming a time?

quiz.explanation: keep in touch 在本课中指保持联系。
quiz.prompt: What does “keep in touch” mean in this lesson?
